hints.title: Sorting Smallest Elements Left
hints.text: Sorting any substring allows a smaller digit to move left past a larger digit, but a larger digit can never move left past a smaller digit.

hints.title: Digit Index Queues
hints.text: Store the indices of each digit 0 through 9 in s in separate ordered queues.

hints.title: Blocking Condition
hints.text: To place digit d from s to match t, no digit strictly smaller than d can appear before d in s. Check if pos[smaller][0] < pos[d][0].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating physical bubble sorts or permutations is factorial.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 10 digit queues allow verifying the leftward movement condition in O(10) per character.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies the inversion invariant: smaller digits can never be crossed right-to-left by larger digits.
complexity.notes: Strings s and t have equal lengths.
